# llmproxy/docker-compose.yml
services:
  llmproxy:
    image: ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:main-latest
    ports: ["4000:4000"]
    volumes: ["./litellm_config.yaml:/app/config.yaml:ro"]
    command: ["--config", "/app/config.yaml", "--port", "4000"]
    extra_hosts: ["host.docker.internal:host-gateway"]
    restart: unless-stopped
description: Docker Compose service for llmproxy with routing config mounted read-only and host.docker.internal resolved.

steps.description: Service definition: llmproxy service uses the litellm main-latest image.
Ports: container port 4000 is published to host port 4000.
Volumes: the routing config is mounted read-only at /app/config.yaml.
Extra_hosts: host.docker.internal maps to host-gateway for Linux resolution.
